Welcome. I remember 4 or 5 years ago jumping from Digg to Reddit, and a few months back from Reddit to Voat. I think innovation is the key, and once a site hits stagnation, it's good for something new to come along and strip away all of the excess buildup that inevitably creeps in with the changing of the guard. It kind of reminds me of how, I believe Jefferson thought that the government should be completely re-started every 17 years to ensure that the current generations ideals were represented, and to prevent an entrenched elite from seizing power away from the people. I think it's inevitable that whenever someone new is brought on board to helm a site, there will be a gradual shift in priorities, and I think that the only way we can 'vote' is by whether or not we continue to contribute content and bestow relevance upon it.
